key_reasoning.reason: Diff spans a new shared dropdown component (NavigationMore, reused by both ChatSidebar and ProjectMembersManager), a full ChatSidebar/ChatSidebarLists subsystem refactor (FocusedChatSidebar, FocusedAggregateRow, FocusedViewHeader, chatSidebarFolderHelpers, chatSidebarListsHelpers, focusedChatSidebarViewModel, useChatSidebarFolders, useChatSidebarSections), a new chat-import feature (icon + constants), and the targeted ProjectMembersManager unassign-hiding change — four+ components across multiple product areas with new abstractions introduced.
